assets.brief: Small ivory survey craft, split swept manta fins, dark inset canopy, copper equipment collars, two teal thruster sockets. Asymmetric scanner on starboard. No weapons in this candidate.
Three arching plum stems cradle luminous ribbed seed bladders. Low folded basal leaves, copper tips. Distinct silhouette at flight distance.
Buoyant peach bell, recessed underside, three dark eyes with tiny highlights, six tapering curled feeding tendrils and small side fins. Curious and slightly unsettling, not a humanoid.
An incomplete split stone arch containing a dormant copper coil. A single luminous seam activates when the bed blooms; no readable ancestor recording.
